item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "889bcce00d5097c614ab7328dbc67da347eb278028a1550966eb63dc11960652",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "For flux f and state x, there exists a continuous real-linear map B such that f has Fréchet derivative B at x and the standard-coordinate matrix of B satisfies LocalDef004.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side asserts existence of a derivative whose matrix has a real eigenbasis. Its derivative witness is bound internally, separately from the given derivative A.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism of the real numbers forms an inverse pair with itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies structural compatibility for real-linear equivalences used in matrix conversion; adds no hypothesis on flux or state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "For every natural number m, the two real scalar actions on real coordinate vectors commute: a • (b • v) = b • (a • v).",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports scalar multiplication on spaces of real-linear maps and the matrix conversion equivalence; imposes no additional restriction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "A real square matrix C indexed by a finite type ι satisfies this predicate when there exist λ : ι → R and a basis b of the real vector space ι → R, indexed by ι, such that C b_p = λ_p b_p for every p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires a full real eigenbasis for the derivative matrix, hence diagonalizability over R, with no distinctness requirement on eigenvalues.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "A commutative semiring is an algebra over itself via the identity map, with scalar action given by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalars act on real coordinates by ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real scalar action underlying the coordinatewise eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction: both propositions must hold.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires both linear independence and all eigenvector equations on the right, and both differentiability and the matrix property on the left.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains a commutative semiring's semiring structure and operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real semiring operations needed for the scalar action without changing them.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap",
      "meaning": "A continuous additive map respecting scalar multiplication through the specified ring homomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "Because the homomorphism is the identity on R, the derivative is a continuous real-linear endomorphism of R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap.funLike",
      "meaning": "Views a continuous linear map as its underlying function, using its underlying linear map.",
      "effect_on_target": "The expression derivative (eigenvectors p) applies the derivative operator to a vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function from a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables evaluation of the derivative; introduces no new mathematical operation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField",
      "meaning": "A densely normed field supplies a nontrivially normed field with the same normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar-field structure required for real Fréchet differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvector equations are exact equalities of coordinate vectors, equivalently equality in every coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "There is a witness of the indicated type satisfying the following predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Binds whole eigenvalue and eigenvector families on the right, and a derivative, eigenvalue family, and basis on the left.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fin",
      "meaning": "Fin m is the type of natural-number indices p satisfying 0 ≤ p < m.",
      "effect_on_target": "Both vector coordinates and eigenvector labels have exactly m indices; both are empty when m = 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts scalar multiplication on values to scalar multiplication on functions pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "For each coordinate i, (λ_p • v_p)(i) = λ_p v_p(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a heterogeneous scalar-action structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Denotes ordinary real scalar multiplication of coordinate vectors in the eigenvector equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HasFDerivAt",
      "meaning": "The function has the specified Fréchet derivative at the point, using the neighborhood filter at that point and a fixed base point. Here f(x+h) − f(x) − A(h) = o(‖h‖) as h → 0.",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes differentiability at the single state with derivative A; the same predicate constrains the derivative witness in LocalDef001.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence, asserting implication in both directions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Equates the existential derivative-matrix eigenbasis property with the specified derivative having m independent real eigenvectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed-space structure from an inner-product-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Participates in constructing the usual real scalar module structure; does not require orthogonality of the eigenvectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "LinearIndependent",
      "meaning": "The map from finitely supported scalar coefficients to their linear combination of the family is injective. Here Σ_p c_p v_p = 0 implies c_p = 0 for every p.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires all m vectors to be jointly linearly independent over R; thus each existing vector is nonzero, and the family is a basis of R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Nat",
      "meaning": "The natural numbers, including zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "The dimension m is any nonnegative integer, without a positivity assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the underlying nonunital seminormed ring structure, forgetting the commutativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations and seminorm used in constructing scalar-space instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive group, norm, and pseudometric of a nonunital seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual seminormed additive structure on R for the normed-space instance.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations, norm, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Changes only the structural interface used for R; does not replace its norm or topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the algebraic module structure from a normed space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the ordinary real module structure used to define linearity and linear independence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "The module of functions into a module, with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes Fin m → R the coordinate vector space R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "Pi.addCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative groups form an additive commutative group pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector addition, negation, and subtraction in differentiability are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Functions into additive commutative monoids form an additive commutative monoid pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides coordinatewise vector addition and zero for linear maps and linear combinations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "Pi.topologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "The product topology, constructed from the topologies induced by all coordinate evaluations.",
      "effect_on_target": "R^m has its usual finite product topology for continuity and Fréchet differentiation.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform space associated with a pseudometric space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Transfers the usual real metric structure toward the topology used on each coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Views an RCLike field as a real inner product space with its associated normed-space structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specialized to R, supplies the ordinary real normed vector space used to obtain scalar multiplication; asserts no inner-product condition on the derivative.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Coordinates, scalars, and eigenvalues are real; the proposition is about real diagonalizability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "Real.denselyNormedField",
      "meaning": "The real numbers form a densely normed field with their usual normed-field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real analytic scalar structure for the derivative predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative group structure of R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real addition and subtraction, lifted to coordinate vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative monoid structure of R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero for coordinate modules and finite linear combinations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure of R.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity real algebra and standard matrix representation with ordinary real arithmetic.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The real RCLike structure: real-part map is the identity, imaginary-part map and distinguished imaginary element are zero, and the normed field is the real one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides real normed and inner-product instances; does not enlarge the scalar field to C.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The ordinary real commutative ring with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides compatible algebraic and analytic structure for the coordinate scalar space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The real field with its usual norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the normed scalar field for the real vector spaces and their derivatives.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real.pseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "The real pseudometric structure with distance d(x,y) = |x − y|.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines the usual topology on each coordinate and therefore on R^m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The semiring structure of R using real addition and multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the scalar arithmetic for real-linear maps and coordinate modules.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "RingHom.id",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism, sending each scalar to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the maps real-linear, so A(a v) = a A(v), with no scalar twisting.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the operations, norm, and pseudometric of a seminormed commutative ring while forgetting its unit structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies an intermediate real instance without changing the mathematics of the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the underlying nonassociative-semiring interface of a semiring with the same operations.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the structure needed to form the identity ring homomorphism on R.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the usual real topology used by the finite product topology.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Views an ordinary scalar action as a heterogeneous scalar action with the same output type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed scalar multiplication is exactly the existing real action on vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap",
      "meaning": "Forgets the continuity field of a continuous linear map and keeps its underlying linear map.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix in LocalDef001 represents the same derivative operator, with no change to its action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "DFinsupp.instEquivLikeLinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "Supplies the equivalence-like interface of a linear equivalence, including its underlying bijection.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the linear equivalence converting maps to matrices to be applied to the derivative's linear map.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Views an equivalence-like object as its forward function.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applies the forward map of the standard-coordinate matrix conversion and the basis-coordinate equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Fin.fintype",
      "meaning": "Enumerates every element of Fin n exactly once using the finite range of n indices.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the finite coordinate set required for matrix-vector multiplication and basis indexing.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "LinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "An invertible semilinear map with compatible inverse scalar homomorphism; for identity real homomorphisms, a real-linear isomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conversion between coordinate linear maps and matrices is an isomorphism, so its representation preserves the complete operator.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "LinearMap",
      "meaning": "An additive map respecting scalar multiplication through a specified ring homomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative's underlying map and the matrix representation use ordinary real-linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "LinearMap.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Linear maps have pointwise addition and zero, inherited through their underlying functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the additive structure on the domain of the map-to-matrix linear equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "LinearMap.module",
      "meaning": "Linear maps form a module under pointwise multiplication of outputs by scalars, when the scalar actions commute.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real module structure needed to regard matrix conversion as a real-linear equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "LinearMap.toMatrix'",
      "meaning": "Maps a coordinate linear map B to the matrix C with C_ij = (B e_j)_i, where e_j has coordinate 1 at j and 0 elsewhere; its inverse is matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The matrix acts on column coordinate vectors exactly as B does. Its eigenbasis condition concerns right eigenvectors of B.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A matrix with row index type m, column index type n, and entries in α is a function m → n → α.",
      "effect_on_target": "The derivative matrix is an m-by-m real array indexed by Fin m in both positions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "Matrix.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Matrices inherit entrywise addition and zero from their entries.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive structure for the matrix side of the coordinate representation equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "Matrix.module",
      "meaning": "Matrices inherit entrywise scalar multiplication from their entries.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes real matrices a real module for the linear map-to-matrix equivalence.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "NonAssocSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Forgets unit structure while retaining addition and multiplication in a nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the algebraic interface used by finite matrix arithmetic without changing real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid from a nonunital nonassociative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides addition and zero for the relevant real modules and sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Semiring.toModule",
      "meaning": "A semiring acts on itself as a module by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar action used in coordinate matrix representation is ordinary real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "instDecidableEqFin",
      "meaning": "Equality of finite indices is decidable by comparing their underlying natural numbers.",
      "effect_on_target": "Enables construction of standard coordinate vectors e_j; adds no mathematical restriction on m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "AddCommMonoid.toAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive monoid structure of an additive commutative monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the scalar-action hierarchy with the same vector addition and zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the additive group and commutative multiplication of a commutative ring while forgetting unit structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real arithmetic for matrix-vector multiplication through a weaker structural interface.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "DistribMulAction.toMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying multiplicative action from a distributive multiplicative action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action used in the eigenbasis equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite type equipped with an exhaustive finite enumeration.",
      "effect_on_target": "LocalDef004 uses finite square matrices and finite coordinate sums; the target specializes this to Fin m.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication: (C v)_i is the dot product of row i with v, namely Σ_j C_ij v_j.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenbasis equations in LocalDef004 are ordinary right eigenvector equations for column vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed algebraic basis of a module, giving unique finite scalar coordinates for every vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side requires eigenvectors that both span and are linearly independent, not merely a family of eigenvectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at an index by applying its inverse coordinate representation to the coefficient vector supported there with value 1.",
      "effect_on_target": "The vector eigenbasis p is the p-th basis vector itself, expressed in the ambient coordinate space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "Module.toDistribMulAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distributive scalar action from a module.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the existing real scalar multiplication used by the eigenbasis equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "Monoid.toSemigroup",
      "meaning": "Retains a monoid's associative multiplication as a semigroup structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports scalar-action instances without adding conditions to the target.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "MonoidWithZero.toMonoid",
      "meaning": "Retains multiplication and the unit from a monoid with zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative monoid used by scalar actions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "MulAction.toSemigroupAction",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying semigroup action from a monoid action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the scalar action through the instance hierarchy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the nonunital commutative ring operations while forgetting the associativity field.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an intermediate real arithmetic structure for matrix multiplication without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Retains the underlying nonunital nonassociative ring structure, forgetting commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the matrix-vector arithmetic interface with ordinary real addition and multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, zero, multiplication, and distributivity while forgetting additive inverses.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real structure required by Matrix.mulVec; no arithmetic operation changes.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.commRing",
      "meaning": "The commutative ring structure of the real numbers with their usual arithmetic and integer embeddings.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the real arithmetic used in matrix-vector products and scalar equations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "RingHomInvPair",
      "meaning": "Compatibility asserting that the specified reverse ring homomorphism is a left inverse of the forward ring homomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "For the identity real homomorphism this is automatic; it supports the linear-equivalence interfaces and adds no flux assumption.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "SMulCommClass",
      "meaning": "Two scalar actions commute on their common target: a • (b • v) = b • (a • v).",
      "effect_on_target": "The real actions on coordinate vectors commute, enabling the real module structure on linear maps.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "SemigroupAction.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar multiplication operation from a semigroup action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the same real scalar-vector multiplication appearing in LocalDef004.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "Semiring.toMonoidWithZero",
      "meaning": "Extracts multiplication, unit, and absorbing zero from a semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real multiplicative structure underlying the scalar-action instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify a natural number m, including m = 0; write I = {0, …, m − 1} and V = R^I.",
      "Universally quantify a function f : V → V, denoted flux.",
      "Universally quantify a point x ∈ V, denoted state.",
      "Universally quantify a continuous real-linear map A : V → V, denoted derivative.",
      "On the left of the equivalence, existentially quantify a continuous real-linear map B : V → V; then existentially quantify μ : I → R and an I-indexed real basis b of V for the standard matrix of B.",
      "On the right, existentially quantify an entire family λ : I → R, followed by an entire family v : I → V. The witnesses can depend on the fixed m, f, x, and A, and v is chosen within the scope of λ.",
